sm_top.sm: Houthi missile attacks struck King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, prompting international condemnation.
Saudi Arabia suspended flights and reported missile and drone attacks targeting its airports and oil infrastructure.
UAE officials confirmed that a Flydubai co-pilot planned a suicide attack on Tel Aviv.
A product tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz.
North Korea launched a ballistic missile into the East Sea.
Airstrikes and explosions were reported in the Yemeni capital of Sanaa, targeting Sanaa airport.
A Houthi missile attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport resulted in casualties and temporary suspension of operations.
Allegations of Eritrean troop incursions into Tigray deepened the rift with Ethiopia, threatening regional peace.
Ukrainian drone strikes damaged Yandex data centers in Russia.
Reports emerged of maritime security incidents and vessels struck by projectiles in the Gulf region.
Yemeni government forces repelled a Houthi attack near Bab el-Mandeb in Taiz.
An unexploded munition detonated near the Lebanon border, killing one Israeli and injuring several others.
An airstrike near the Egypt-Sudan border killed 72 artisanal gold miners, prompting an investigation.
An RSF drone attack in Sudan's Blue Nile region caused casualties and damage.
Houthi missile and drone strikes hit Riyadh, killing at least 13 people.
Airstrikes in Sanaa killed 1 and injured 12, prompting Saudi forces to respond.
Ukrainian drone strikes hit oil facilities in Russia's Samara Region, causing large fires.
Iran's IRGC attacked and struck supertankers in the Strait of Hormuz.
A medical facility caught fire in Kharkiv following a Russian drone attack.
Russian bombs hit apartment buildings in Sloviansk, injuring nine people.
At least 71 people were killed in intercommunal clashes in Rumbek, South Sudan.
Drone strikes targeting a dormitory and shelter killed 10 people in El-Obeid, Sudan.
Russian drones struck Kyiv, hitting a 25-story apartment building and killing one woman while injuring several others.
Seventeen nations joined NATO's Steadfast Noon annual nuclear deterrence exercise hosted by Italy.
Russian forces launched a mass missile and drone attack across Ukraine, killing at least 16 to 20 people.
The Saudi-led coalition destroyed a Houthi ballistic missile heading toward Riyadh.
A Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia killed at least 20 people.
The Arab coalition intercepted and destroyed a drone in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province.
Russian attacks targeting energy infrastructure across several Ukrainian oblasts killed 10 people and injured 69 while air defenses intercepted 89 drones.
Ethiopian troops recaptured the regional capital of Tigray, prompting promises of administrative change.
A Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia killed at least 20 people, including children.
A migrant boat capsized off the coast of Djibouti, leaving 109 dead and 116 missing.
Yemeni government military forces report advancing against the Houthis, claiming 1,150 Houthi fighters killed over the past 24 hours.
Russian MoD claimed a dry cargo ship delivering military goods to Ukrainian ports was struck.
Kyiv faces widespread power outages following renewed Russian attacks on energy facilities.
A rights group reported a paramilitary drone strike killed 41 people near a displacement camp in Sudan near the Ethiopian border.
Russian guided aerial bombs struck Zaporizhzhia, resulting in multiple casualties.
Yemen's Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition trade fresh strikes.
Ukrainian President Zelenskyy states that Russian strikes have killed at least 32 people in Ukraine.
Over 100 people died when a boat heading towards Yemen capsized in the Red Sea.
